subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 7: Phonics (i-e, a-e, o-e, u-e)
outcomes: I can say the magic-e sounds in bike, cake, stone, cube and tube.
I can use do and does in questions and short answers.

tf.s: In bike, the e at the end is silent.
tf.why: Yes! The e is silent and makes i say its name.

tf.s: The magic e makes the vowel say its name.
tf.why: Right! a-e in cake says a.

tf.s: Cake has the split vowel o-e.
When we add e to kit, we get kite.
We ask: Does you speak English?
tf.why: With you we say Do: Do you speak English?

tf.s: We ask: Does she like cake?
tf.why: Yes! does goes with he and she.

tf.s: Short answer: Does he play the flute? No, he don't.
We use do with I and you.
tf.why: Right! Do you …? Yes, I do.

boxes.q: cub → cube. What does the e do?
o: It makes u say its name.
boxes.why: Magic e makes the vowel say its name.

boxes.q: Answer: Does he play the flute? (no)
Complete: ___ she like cake? Yes, she ___.
A small hard rock is a …
boxes.why: A stone is a small hard rock.

mcq.q: Which word has the same vowel sound as gate?
mcq.why: gate and cake both have a-e.

mcq.q: Which word has the same vowel sound as phone?
mcq.why: phone and stone both have o-e.

o: The boy has got a cube, a bike, a cake and a stone.
The girl has got a hat, a cat and a mat.
mcq.why: The boy has got a cube, a bike, a cake and a stone.

mcq.q: Which is a tricky word in this lesson?
mcq.why: do and does are the tricky words.

mcq.q: Ask your partner about his sister and cake.
Answer: Do you ride a bike to school? (no)
Complete the word: k_t_ (it flies in the sky)
cub has no e. cube has an e. What changes?
mcq.why: Magic e makes u say its name.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT have magic e?
mcq.why: cub has no e at the end.

mcq.q: Sort: I, you, he, she. Which two go with does?
mcq.why: he and she go with does.
